lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb4Li3I2 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 19 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows iodine centers in octahedral environments with six Li neighbors, while lithium centers adopt 12-neighbor, close-packed-like arrangements; rubidium centers show 12-neighbor or 2-neighbor Li-only coordination. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 19 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Li 12-vertex and I octahedral polyhedra, and edge-sharing between I octahedra.
